categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies compact block message handling and serialization caching for relay in src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Caches serialized compact block messages across high-bandwidth and low-bandwidth peers, serving primarily as preparation for compact block prefilling in PR #35558. The author notes that 'on its own should have little impact on block propagation, but these refactors are useful as part of #35558 which adds prefilling of compact blocks' (PR description).
